In compliance with the Listing Rules, targets are established by the Board at the beginning of every financial year for each ma o i s o l l i i the effectiveness of the Group's ESG policies as well as overseeing a team of ESG professionals (the "Team"). ESGGOVERNANCE / OUR SUSTAINABILITY MISSION

[Content]
Through adopting a top-down approach, the Board of Directors (the "Board") are responsible for developing the Group's sustainable business strategy as well as spearheading our Green Strategy to contribute our nation's carbon neutrality goal.
